say:1:1741113001:1.text: Why are you staring like that? Just because people know who I am now doesn't mean I can't go outside.
say:1:1741113001:1.source_cn: 大惊小怪地看着我做什么？难道身份暴露之后，本狐就不能出...
say:1:1741113001:1.male: Why are you staring like that? Just because people know who I am now doesn't mean I can't go outside.
say:1:1741113001:1.female: Why are you staring like that? Just because people know who I am now doesn't mean I can't go outside.

say:2:1741113002:1.text: Savannah has plenty of foxes. Granted, I'm the most extraordinary one, but with the right disguise, who could possibly tell?
say:2:1741113002:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳又不是只有我一只狐狸，虽然本狐是其中最特别的一只...
say:2:1741113002:1.male: Savannah has plenty of foxes. Granted, I'm the most extraordinary one, but with the right disguise, who could possibly tell?
say:2:1741113002:1.female: Savannah has plenty of foxes. Granted, I'm the most extraordinary one, but with the right disguise, who could possibly tell?

say:4:1741113003:1.text: I-It's the little fox! Wait, no, King Rolan! Your Majesty, I'm a big fan!
say:4:1741113003:1.source_cn: 是、是小狐狸！不，是罗兰大帝！罗兰大帝，我是你的粉丝！

say:5:1741113004:1.text: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?
say:5:1741113004:1.source_cn: 哎，怎、怎么围过来的人越来越多了？
say:5:1741113004:1.male: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?
say:5:1741113004:1.female: Wait, why is everyone gathering around us?

say:6:1741113005:1.text: Nope. Time to go. Merlin, remember: you never saw me here!
say:6:1741113005:1.source_cn: 不好，我先溜了！梅林，记住，你可没有在这里见过我哦！
say:6:1741113005:1.male: Nope. Time to go. Merlin, remember: you never saw me here!
say:6:1741113005:1.female: Nope. Time to go. Merlin, remember: you never saw me here!
